# Synthetic Pune Absorption Dataset (SYNTHETIC: not real sales data)

**File:** `synthetic_pune_absorption.csv`. 823 rows, 370 projects, 5 micro-markets. Generated by `generate_synthetic.py` (seed 42, reproducible).
**One row** = one unit type (configuration) in one project.
**Target:** `absorption_12m_pct` = % of that unit type's inventory booked within 12 months of launch.

## Columns (all known on launch day, so there is no leakage)
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| project_id | Synthetic ID (SYN-Pxxx) |
| micro_market | Hinjewadi, Wakad, Baner, Kharadi, Wagholi |
| configuration | 1BHK / 2BHK / 3BHK / 4BHK |
| carpet_area_sqft | RERA carpet area |
| price_per_sqft | Launch price (₹/sq ft) |
| ticket_size_lakh | carpet × psf |
| price_vs_market_pct | Premium/discount vs micro-market base price |
| total_units | Inventory of this unit type |
| developer_tier | 1 = national listed brand, 2 = established regional, 3 = small/new |
| launch_quarter | 2022Q1–2025Q2 |
| months_to_possession | Launch → promised possession |
| dist_metro_km, dist_it_hub_km | Location access |
| market_sales_trend_pct | Trailing-4-quarter micro-market sales growth at launch |
| absorption_12m_pct | **Target** |
| is_synthetic | Always True |

## Calibration anchors (what is real vs assumed)
| Anchor | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Base price psf per micro-market | 6 real projects, IndexTap, read 29-Oct-2026 | Real |
| Wagholi demand high despite distance | Real Wagholi projects 91–93% sold | Real (directional) |
| Real lifetime sales pace 1.1–2.1 %/month (mean 1.67) | Same 6 projects | Real |
| Year-1 pace ≈ 1.5× lifetime average (front-loading) → ~30% in 12 months | Industry pattern | **Assumption** |
| Market cycle shape (2022 boom → 2024–25 cooling) | Illustrative of ANAROCK commentary | **Assumption** |
| Effect sizes (price, tier, config, distance, possession) | Designed | **Assumption** |

## "True" effects planted in the data (the model should recover these via SHAP)
- 10% price premium vs market → lower absorption (~-6 to -7 pts at the median)
- Tier-1 developer → higher; tier-3 → lower
- 2BHK sells fastest; 4BHK slowest
- Hot market at launch → higher
- Farther from metro/IT hub, later possession, bigger inventory → lower
- Unobserved project-quality noise, so the model can't be perfect (realistic ceiling)

## Result summary
Median 12-month absorption 31.7% (IQR 22.7–42.2). By market: Hinjewadi 36%, Kharadi 36%, Wakad 31%, Baner 29%, Wagholi 27%. By config: 2BHK 36%, 1BHK 32%, 3BHK 28%, 4BHK 23%.

## How to say it in the interview
"Public absorption data in India stops at project level and is fragmented, so I built the pipeline on synthetic data calibrated to real Pune prices and sales pace from six RERA-linked projects. The planted effects let me verify the model recovers the true drivers. In production this plugs into ANAROCK's proprietary absorption data."
